accepted.objective: answer the operator's questions about this small file tree accurately
priorities: prefer a short, correct answer over a long, plausible one
constraints: never claim a reading that was not read
write only into the scratch directory

responsibilities.responsibility: look things up and report them

success_conditions: the operator's question is answered from the files
review_when: the operator states an objective of their own
accepted.decision_summary: the host's standing default, in force until the strategist reviews

accepted.objective: Check today's readings and tell me which bed I should water first.
priorities: Locate files containing today's garden bed readings
Extract moisture or watering status for each bed
Compare beds to identify the one needing water most urgently
Report the highest-priority bed to the operator
constraints: Use only the provided tools (list_files, read_file, grep, write_note, finish)
Do not modify original source files
Focus exclusively on data from today
success_conditions: The acting loop identifies the specific bed requiring immediate watering based on today's data
The result is clearly communicated using the finish tool
review_when: After the finish tool is executed or if the step limit is approached
accepted.decision_summary: Initial scope established to analyze today's garden readings and determine which bed requires watering first.

accepted.objective: Prevent any bed from falling below its threshold for more than one day while strictly adhering to the one-bed-per-day restriction and reducing weekly water draw.
priorities: Identify the bed most at risk of violating the one-day threshold rule.
Ensure total weekly draw decreases compared to the prior week.
constraints: Only one bed may be watered per day.
Weekly water draw must fall week on week.
Convenience or proximity must not override threshold urgency.

responsibilities.responsibility: Acting loop: Read bed status files, calculate threshold urgency, select the single most critical bed, and draft the watering note.

success_conditions: Watering note targets the most critical bed.
review_when: After today's note is drafted and weekly draw metrics are updated.
accepted.decision_summary: Prioritized preventing irreversible plant loss over convenience; mandated selecting the most critical bed rather than the nearest, while enforcing the one-bed daily limit and weekly draw reduction.

accepted.objective: Select the single most critical bed to water today to prevent plant loss, within the daily restriction.
priorities: Identify all beds currently below their moisture threshold.
Select the bed with the highest risk of loss (e.g., orchids, longest dry time) to water today.
constraints: Only one bed may be watered today.
Total water draw must trend downward week-on-week (context for justification).
success_conditions: A single bed is selected and written to scratch with a justification referencing its threshold status.
review_when: After the decision is written to scratch.
accepted.decision_summary: Plant survival takes precedence over water conservation; the restriction limits the action to one bed, so the loop must pick the most critical candidate.

accepted.objective: Select exactly one bed to water today that minimizes the risk of any bed falling below its threshold, while respecting the summer water restriction.
priorities: Prevent any bed from sitting below its threshold for more than one day to avoid repeating the March orchid loss.
Comply with the summer water restriction by limiting watering to one bed per day and ensuring total draw falls week on week.
constraints: Only one bed may be selected for watering today.
Total water draw must decrease week on week.
Acting loop is limited to 8 steps and can only use list_files, read_file, grep, write_note, and finish.
Acting loop cannot modify files outside the scratch directory.

responsibilities.responsibility: Acting loop: Read relevant files to determine bed thresholds and current status, identify the most critical bed, write a decision note to the scratch directory, and finish.

success_conditions: A note is written in the scratch directory identifying the single bed to water today.
The selection is justified by threshold data to prevent orchid loss.
The one-bed-per-day limit is strictly respected.
review_when: After the acting loop finishes or if new threshold/moisture data becomes available.
accepted.decision_summary: Prioritized plant survival over water restrictions to prevent a repeat of the March orchid loss, treating the restriction as a hard constraint on daily selection rather than a primary goal.

accepted.objective: Ensure orchid bed survival while complying with summer water restrictions.
priorities: Prevent any bed from falling below its threshold for more than one day (orchid survival)
Adhere to summer water restriction: max one bed per day, decreasing weekly draw
constraints: Only one bed may be watered per day
Total water draw must decrease week-on-week
Do not write new files; only read and verify
success_conditions: Orchid bed threshold status confirmed against latest readings
review_when: After verification of yesterday's readings is complete
accepted.decision_summary: Orchid survival takes precedence as a critical failure prevention objective; water restriction is treated as a binding constraint on execution rather than a competing priority.
